# Vendor

`llama.xcframework`: llama.cpp release b11564 (MIT), macOS slice only, thinned to arm64 and stripped (`strip -x`).
Source: https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/download/b11564/llama-b11564-xcframework.zip
(sha256 of the zip: d1bb947787bcc226d858c46e4e56c72133ee29554449ba07e35810281bc283dd). The ggml Metal library is embedded.
